name: Subscribe button
what: The call to action: a Like button, a Subscribe button and a bell pop in; a cursor clicks each - the like fills with a burst, the button turns grey and says Subscribed, the bell rings - then they pop away.
origin: subscribe / notification-bell animations - the template kinds marketplaces list (Mixkit, Envato Elements, Motion Array, Videohive), researched 2026-10-16
motion: pops back.out 12 f, 4 f apart; the cursor glides 14 f (S-curve) and clicks (3 f press, 5 f release); the bell swings 6 x 3 f; away back.in 8 f
